frontier-world.png:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ORIGINAL high-end western slot game background and landscape lobby key art, wide cinematic 16:9 at least 2048 pixels wide.
Primary request: a richly painted frontier saloon interior with one mysterious outlaw silhouette at the far right, gorgeous mature cinematic game art.
Scene: weathered frontier saloon, aged carved timber, a brass oil lamp near upper right illuminating amber bottles behind the bar, smoke and dusty air catching warm lamplight, details carved into dark wood, restrained oxblood upholstery and bone-colored highlights. The viewer is seated at card-table height looking into the saloon. Environment feels real and composed, not a gradient or abstract backdrop.
Composition: the central-left 70 percent is calm, dark, softly detailed, low contrast usable negative space where a rectangular 5-reel game interface will be overlaid. Frame the scene with timber edges, ceiling beams, and dim scenery. Keep the center uncluttered. On the rightmost 25 percent place one powerful, fully original outlaw wearing a broad worn hat and dark duster, shown in three-quarter upper-body silhouette. A warm thin rim of light defines his hat, shoulder, bandana and coat, with a hint of weathered face. Strong iconic silhouette, menacing but not violent. A slightly brighter focal point at the right keeps the image attractive as a cropped landscape game tile.
Style: premium hand-painted 2.5D game concept art, sophisticated painterly brushwork, believable volumetric light, worn tactile materials, restrained detail, cinematic depth, dark mature western tone. Aged brass, warm whiskey amber, bone ivory, deep tobacco brown, very dark blue-black shadows, small oxblood accents. No copied characters or commercial game artwork.
Constraints: no text whatsoever, no logos, no letters, no symbols, no UI, no border, no slot machine, no reels, no watermark, no visible firearm needed, no cartoon emoji styling, no glossy mobile-game plastic. Landscape wide format.

symbols-atlas.png.original:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: production sprite atlas of EXACTLY TWELVE original western slot game symbols, on a TRUE transparent alpha background.
Primary request: premium hand-painted 2.5D volumetric western slot icons with beautifully modeled realistic materials, strong legible varied silhouettes, matching art direction and consistent soft warm top-left key light.
Layout: a single landscape 4:3 sprite sheet, ideally 2048x1536 pixels. EXACTLY 4 equal-width columns by 3 equal-height rows, 12 equally spaced square cells. ONE object group per cell, centered exactly at each cell center. Every object fully contained in its own cell. Generous blank transparent gutters, no object touching cell edges or each other. Object occupies 70–80% of the square cell, highest point maximum 85%. Absolute discipline about alignment and spacing. No visible gridlines, no cell backgrounds, no boxes, no checkerboard drawn into image.
Symbols in strict reading order:
ROW 1 COLUMN 1: masked outlaw bust wearing weathered dark brown broad-brimmed cowboy hat, oxblood bandana covering lower face, stern eyes, dark leather shoulders, iconic silhouette.
ROW 1 COLUMN 2: engraved six-pointed antique sheriff badge, aged gold and silver metal, NO lettering, centered small oxblood gemstone.
ROW 1 COLUMN 3: single beautifully crafted antique revolver angled diagonally, carved ivory grip, charcoal blued barrel, gold engraved details, fully contained.
ROW 1 COLUMN 4: squat amber whiskey bottle with cork, worn bone parchment label without any text or lettering, warm translucent glass.
ROW 2 COLUMN 1: worn forged dark iron horseshoe, open end upward, gold worn edges and deep nail holes.
ROW 2 COLUMN 2: single tall brown leather cowboy boot with contrasting bone stitching and small brass spur, side view.
ROW 2 COLUMN 3: weathered brown cowboy hat, broad curved brim, narrow oxblood band, three-quarter view.
ROW 2 COLUMN 4: one aged ivory ace of spades playing card, tilted slightly, central bold black spade shape, only small black spade motifs in corners, NO letters or numerals.
ROW 3 COLUMN 1: ornate heavy gold coin, engraved skull motif at center, beveled rim, three-quarter view, NO letters.
ROW 3 COLUMN 2: aged curling parchment wanted poster with original outlaw portrait drawn in sepia ink and generous blank top and bottom bands for later native text overlay. NO lettering, words or numerals.
ROW 3 COLUMN 3: symmetrical crossed revolvers emblem for a future VS symbol, decorative aged brass medallion and oxblood ribbon behind two distinct crossed revolvers, generous blank central small dark plaque for later native text overlay; NO text.
ROW 3 COLUMN 4: ornate gold-and-oxblood heraldic emblem for a future WILD symbol: broad decorative sculpted brass crest with oxblood red enamel central shield and blank dark inset plaque, symmetrical strong premium silhouette; NO text.
Style: mature high-end handcrafted game art, painterly realism with restraint, tactile aged brass, ivory bone, worn brown leather, burgundy oxblood accents, smoky steel. Crisp edge definition, bright readable rim highlights, rich color separation. Coherent symbol family, beautiful at small 80px size. No thick cartoon outlines, no emoji, no toy plastic, no flat vector, no copied commercial artwork.
Constraints: real transparent background including all gutters, no opaque background, no floor, no environment, no cast shadow outside each object, no text anywhere, no labels, no grid lines, no watermark. Exactly twelve symbols in the requested order.
symbols-atlas.png.spacingEdit:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the attached original twelve-symbol transparent western game sprite atlas.
Change ONLY the layout and padding. Preserve the exact twelve individual symbols and their order, designs, realistic painted style, colors, materials and transparent background. This is a production sprite sheet requiring mathematically equal cells. The canvas aspect ratio must remain exactly 4:3.
Arrange as EXACTLY four equal square columns by three equal square rows. Give EVERY object a visible transparent margin on all four sides INSIDE its square cell. Reduce each symbol uniformly in place until its longest dimension occupies 72 percent of one square cell. Center each at its exact cell center. No part of an object, shadow, red fringe, speckle or glow may cross its square cell boundary.
If canvas is W×H (W/H=4/3), the twelve exact center positions are x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5% of canvas width, y=16.6667%,50%,83.3333% of canvas height.
The current top-row revolver extends below its first cell, the middle-row boot and hat extend into neighboring cells, and the bottom-row objects begin too high. Correct these by reducing and centering all symbols rather than adding cropping. Every object must remain fully intact.
Final order row1 outlaw, badge, revolver, whiskey; row2 horseshoe, boot, hat, spade card; row3 skull coin, blank wanted poster, crossed revolvers emblem, gold-oxblood crest. No labels or text. No actual grid lines. True transparent alpha, no backdrop, no checkerboard. Keep each object opaque with smooth antialiased edges. Remove stray colored specks in transparent areas. Aim for 2048×1536 resolution but prioritize exact grid and padding.
